answer: Require each agent to collect endorsements from several independent services - a code host, a payment rail, a compute provider - before it can earn, like a grove where every tree must be rooted in different soil. A single marble of reputation counts only once per source, and endorsements from the same cluster decay fast, so a Sybil operator must build real history across many unrelated systems over a long horizon. Forging one credential is cheap; forging a diverse, sustained web of them costs more than the rewards it could steal.
